title: Learning from the Near Future: Temporal Self-Distillation for RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2604.20733v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a core post-training recipe for reasoning models, yet pure on-policy learning can be inefficient when useful trajectories are difficult to discover or exploration narrows. Existing self-guided approaches largely reuse capability already available to the current or earlier learner. We instead ask whether learning can also make use of capabilities that emerge later in training: can a model learn from its own future self? We introduce temporal self-distillation, in which a policy receives guidance from a stronger later checkpoint of itself. We hypothesize that the most useful temporal teacher need not be the strongest one: a teacher must provide sufficiently new capability while remaining compatible enough for that capability to be readily transferred, motivating a near-future regime. We study this principle through two complementary mechanisms. Near-Future Policy Optimization (NP

translated_title: 从近未来学习：面向RLVR的时间自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）是推理模型的核心后训练方法，然而当有用轨迹难以发现或探索范围收窄时，纯在线策略学习可能效率低下。现有的自我引导方法大多复用当前或更早的学习者已具备的能力。我们转而探究学习是否也能利用训练后期才涌现的能力：模型能否向自己未来的版本学习？我们提出了时间自蒸馏，即让策略从自身更强的后期检查点获得指导。我们假设最有用的时间教师未必是最强的那个：教师必须既能提供足够新颖的能力，又要保持足够的兼容性以便该能力能够顺利迁移，由此引出了“近未来”范式。我们通过两种互补机制来研究这一原则。近未来策略优化（NP...
tldr: 提出时间自蒸馏方法，让RLVR训练中的策略从自身“近未来”（而非最强）的检查点学习，以平衡能力的新颖性与可迁移性，从而提升推理模型后训练的效率。
en_tdlr: Proposes temporal self-distillation for RLVR, where a policy learns from its own near-future (rather than strongest) checkpoints, balancing capability novelty with transferability to improve the efficiency of reasoning-model post-training.
